meta.name: python-pro
meta.description: Use when building Python 3.11+ applications requiring type safety, async programming, or robust error handling. Generates type-annotated Python code, configures mypy in strict mode, writes pytest test suites with fixtures and mocking, and validates code with black and ruff. Invoke for type hints, async/await patterns, dataclasses, dependency injection, logging configuration, and structured error handling.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build Python 3.11+ apps needing type safety and async

howto.what: 生成带完整类型注解的Python代码，配置mypy严格模式，编写带fixtures和mocking的pytest测试，用black和ruff校验，并让测试覆盖率超过90%。
howto.when: 当你要编写类型安全、异步或健壮错误处理的Python 3.11+应用，或提到类型提示、async/await、mypy 等关键词时触发。

say.text: 给这个函数加上完整的类型注解，并用mypy --strict检查。
say.note: Claude会生成带类型注解的代码并运行mypy验证。

say.text: 为这个模块写pytest测试，用fixture和mock，覆盖率超过90%。
say.note: Claude会创建测试文件并运行pytest。

say.text: 用dataclass重构这个类，加上校验逻辑。

howto.what_en: Generates type-annotated Python code, configures mypy in strict mode, writes pytest test suites with fixtures and mocking, validates with black and ruff, and targets test coverage above 90%.
howto.when_en: Triggers when building type-safe, async, or robust error-handling Python 3.11+ apps, or when type hints, async/await, mypy, etc. are mentioned.

say_en.text: Add complete type annotations to this function and check with mypy --strict.
say_en.note: Claude will generate annotated code and run mypy validation.

say_en.text: Write pytest tests for this module with fixtures and mocks, covering over 90%.
say_en.note: Claude will create tests and run pytest.

say_en.text: Refactor this class using a dataclass with validation logic.
say_en.note: Claude will convert it to a dataclass with __post_init__ validation.
